theorem side_errors {f1 f2 f3 : ℝ} (hs : f1*f2<0) (hn : NormalRun f1 f2 f3) :
    let t:=evaluate f1 f2 f3
    let H:=max |f2-f1| |f3|
    let k:=(1-|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)^2
    Within |t.leftDiff| (originalL f1 f2 f3) ((2*eps+eps^2/2)*H) ∧
    Within t.right (originalR k f1 f2 f3)
      (((3+eps)/2*gamma 2+3*gamma 3+eps/2)*H) := by
  let t:=evaluate f1 f2 f3
  let y:=(f1+f2)/2
  let H:=max |f2-f1| |f3|
  let k:=(1-|(f1+f2)/2|/|f2-f1|)^2
  have hH : 0≤H := (abs_nonneg (f2-f1)).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hyH : |y|≤H/2 := (Cubic.midpoint_bound hs).trans (by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (by norm_num))
  have hzH : |f3|≤H := le_max_right _ _
  have he : 0≤eps := le_of_lt eps_bounds.1
  have hy : Within t.y y (eps*|y|) := relative_error (midpoint_relative hn)
  have hyabs : |t.y|≤(1+eps)*|y| := by
    have hh := abs_add_le (t.y-y) y
    simp only [sub_add_cancel] at hh
    have hy' : |t.y-y|≤eps*|y| :=hy
    nlinarith [hy']
  have hyscaled : |t.y|≤(1+eps)*H/2 := by
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyH (by linarith : 0≤1+eps)
    nlinarith
  have tr := factor_ranges hs hn
  have hkrange : |t.k|≤1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg tr.2.2.2.1]; exact tr.2.2.2.2
  have hk : Within t.k k (2*gamma 3) := factor_error hs hn
  have hleft := within_abs (within_trans
    (relative_error (rounded_relative hn.left)) (within_sub (within_refl f3) hy))
  have hleftabs : |f3-t.y|≤H+(1+eps)*H/2 :=
    (abs_sub _ _).trans (add_le_add hzH hyscaled)
  have hleftbound : eps*|f3-t.y|+(0+eps*|y|)≤(2*eps+eps^2/2)*H := by
    have hm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hleftabs he
    have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyH he
    nlinarith only [hm1,hm2]
  have hsum : Within (|t.y|+|f3|) (|y|+|f3|) (eps*|y|) := by
    simpa using within_add (within_abs hy) (within_refl |f3|)
  have hpert := product_error hkrange hsum hk
    (show |(|y|+|f3|)|≤3*H/2 by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; linarith)
  have hdist := distributed_error
    (a:=t.k*|t.y|) (b:=t.k*|f3|)
    (mul_nonneg tr.2.2.2.1 (abs_nonneg _))
    (mul_nonneg tr.2.2.2.1 (abs_nonneg _))
    (rounded_relative hn.productY) (rounded_relative hn.productZ) (rounded_relative hn.right)
  have hdist' : Within t.right (t.k*(|t.y|+|f3|))
      (gamma 2*(t.k*(|t.y|+|f3|))) := by
    change Within t.right (t.k*|t.y|+t.k*|f3|)
      (gamma 2*(t.k*|t.y|+t.k*|f3|)) at hdist
    simpa only [mul_add] using hdist
  have hsumH : t.k*(|t.y|+|f3|)≤(3+eps)*H/2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right tr.2.2.2.2
      (show 0≤|t.y|+|f3| by positivity)
    nlinarith only [hmul,hyscaled,hzH]
  have hright := within_trans hdist' hpert
  have hrbound : gamma 2*(t.k*(|t.y|+|f3|))+
      (1*(eps*|y|)+(2*gamma 3)*(3*H/2)) ≤
      (((3+eps)/2*gamma 2+3*gamma 3+eps/2)*H) := by
    have hm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsumH (le_of_lt eps_bounds.2.2.1)
    have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyH he
    nlinarith only [hm1,hm2]
  exact ⟨within_mono hleft hleftbound,within_mono hright hrbound⟩

theorem comparison_agreement {G g m : ℝ} (hm : 0≤m)

    field_simp
  simp_rw [hq]
  have ht := (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ=>(1:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1)).div
    ((eta42_tendsto.const_mul 2).const_add 1) (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)+2*0≠0)
  change Tendsto (fun n=>(1:ℝ)/(1+2*eta42Error n)) atTop (𝓝 (1/(1+2*(0:ℝ)))) at ht
  simpa only [mul_zero,add_zero,div_one,one_div] using ht

Fields, hypotheses, and boundaries

ElementManuscriptRole
Binary64: two anonymous instanceseq:formal_rounding_mapValidExp and MonotoneExp for the concrete FLT exponent; used by the rounding theory.
FactorTrace fieldseq:switch_scaled_factorrhoHat,aHat,bHat,vHat,rHat,kHat and their range/error fields. factorTrace proves every field; v_error uses the exact aHat/2.
ScaledTrace fieldseq:switch_scaled_evaluationComputed normalized inputs, midpoint, sides, products, gap and local bounds. scaledTrace supplies all fields.
Unscaled.Values / NormalRun fieldsprop:switch_raw_errorOne stored value and one normality condition per operation. NoOverflow enumerates finiteness of the rounded outputs. These are exact-intermediate domain conditions, not desired error bounds.
ActivePhase.start / width / exceptionlem:adaptive_envelopeInitial phase, successful width test resetting c, or a capped exception incrementing c.
Mode / Step / History constructorsthm:global_simpleBisection stay/start and AB success/exception/fallback transitions. History records finite prefixes; Run supplies an infinite sequence of Step proofs.
CompletedPrefix / Decomposed / Tail constructorsthm:quantitativeFinite-prefix partition and the active/stopped final-tail distinction. history_decomposes proves coverage of all History constructors.
ExactRun fieldsthm:global_simpleInitial bracket and continuity, interior nonzero proposals, the explicit sign update, and width-policy transitions. No limit or shrinkage theorem is a field.
LeftState / leftStep / leftOrbitprop:uncapped_counterexampleExact AB state [−e,1], retained right ordinate, and initial correction flag. Secant and correction identities prove the complete example trajectories; the invariant, limit, and continuation conclusions are not state fields.
Residual estimate hypotheseseq:residual_boundA selected zero z, positive derivative lower bound m, continuity on the bracket, and differentiability in its interior. Uniqueness is unnecessary.
Op / Expr constructors and generated recursorsthm:formal_switchingSyntax constructors, projections and induction principles generated by Lean inherit the mapping of their parent declaration. They are not extra authored lemmas.
Audit.lean, dependency exporter, and source translatorthm:formal_switchingAudit checks transitive axioms of every local theorem. ExportDependencies reads type and proof/value constants from the compiled environment and projects generated local constants to authored declarations. The translator verifies the supplied C# arithmetic AST and wrapper source; it is part of the explicitly trusted source boundary.

The full root-finder state is not asserted to be a binary64 implementation of ExactRun. The convergence theorem applies to the exact sign update and width policy, permitting any interior proposals. The local secant and ordinate-sign lemmas justify the AB proposal; adaptive_step proves the residual-dependent mode decision is admitted. No convergence conclusion is a field of the execution record.

The derivative-based residual-to-distance estimate eq:residual_bound and the distance-to-zero-set estimate eq:distance_zero_set are both formalized. The one-sided and uncapped examples include exact secant/scaling states and the actual bracket updates; they are exact-arithmetic examples.

Versions and reproducibility

Checked locally: lake build; the 380-statement transitive audit; the complete single-file edition; and the compiled dependency export. Only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound are accepted. No source is assumed published at a new GitHub commit.

lake exe cache get
lake build
lake env lean Audit.lean
lake env lean ModAB_Live_Complete.lean
python3 tools/check_audit_coverage.py

See AXIOM_CHECKLIST.md and review/reproduced/lean_audit.log and lean_live_audit.log. The core convergence proof assumes exact real arithmetic and a finite exception cap. Neither the new examples nor the switching theorems certify arbitrary function evaluations or the complete binary64 solver.
